app.title: Deposit & Layaway Plans
app.errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong loading the dashboard.
app.errorBoundary.detail: Reload this page or contact support if the problem continues.
app.dashboard.pageSubtitle: Save deposit plan records, preview schedules, and create order payment requests from Order Details.
app.dashboard.addStoresTitle: Add an eCommerce app to use DepositCraft
app.dashboard.addStoresSubtitle: DepositCraft configures deposit and installment plans for store orders. Add Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Restaurants Orders — or any other Wix eCommerce app — to this site, then return here to set up your plans.
app.dashboard.upgradeSuccessBanner: Pro plan active. Unlimited deposit plans, custom schedules, and priority support are unlocked.
app.dashboard.upgradeSuccessToast: Pro plan active. Unlimited plans and custom schedules are unlocked.
app.storage.checking: Checking whether your storage is set up…
app.storage.provisioning: DepositCraft is still provisioning private storage after install or update. This usually finishes within 10–15 minutes — click Check again or keep this page open.
app.storage.cmsRequired: Add Wix CMS to this site, update this app to the latest version, then click Retry.
app.storage.schemaMismatch: DepositCraft storage on this site does not match the latest app version. Open Manage Apps, update DepositCraft to the latest version, then click Retry.
app.storage.error: We could not confirm storage is set up. Keep this page open and try again, or contact support if this continues.
app.storage.hintProvisioning: App storage is provisioned automatically after install or update. Waiting a few minutes and clicking Check again is usually enough.
app.storage.hintSchemaMismatch: Update the app in Manage Apps so Wix can sync the latest storage schema, then click Retry.
app.storage.hintCmsRequired: Add Wix CMS from the App Market if your site does not have it, then update DepositCraft and click Retry.
app.storage.hintDefault: If this continues, contact support with your Wix request ID.
app.dashboard.supportedSummaryWithRule: Layaway preview at cart/checkout; checkout deposits when you pair each active plan with an automatic discount using its DepositCraft custom trigger (for {ruleName}, about {percent} off when {triggerName} is active); installment payment links from Order Details; due-date Automations emails after you activate an automation for Installment due reminder (Automations → + New Automation → Send an email, timed to the due date).
app.dashboard.supportedSummaryNoRule: Layaway preview at cart/checkout; checkout deposits when you pair each active plan with an automatic discount using its DepositCraft custom trigger; installment payment links from Order Details; due-date Automations emails after you activate an automation for Installment due reminder (Automations → + New Automation → Send an email, timed to the due date).
app.dashboard.notSupportedSummary: Auto-charging saved cards without the buyer present; checkout deposits without your discount setup; collection-scoped plans on orders; external cron or background servers.
app.dashboard.referenceSectionHelperText: See what DepositCraft supports today at checkout, and what still needs setup elsewhere.
app.dashboard.dueInstallmentsDescription: DepositCraft creates the next payment link when a due date passes or after the previous request is marked paid. Customers always pay manually through your Payment Request Page.
app.dashboard.processDueSuccess: {linksCreated, plural, one {Created # payment link} other {Created # payment links}} for {dueCount, plural, one {# due installment} other {# due installments}}.
app.dashboard.processDueAlreadyOpen: Due installments already have an open payment link.
app.dashboard.processDueNoneNow: No installments are due for billing right now.
app.dashboard.processDueError: DepositCraft could not process due installments.
app.dashboard.unlockUnlimitedTitle: Unlock unlimited deposit plans and custom schedules.
app.dashboard.freePlanLimitDescription: Free plans support up to {limit, plural, one {# active percentage-based plan} other {# active percentage-based plans}} on a bi-weekly schedule. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited plans, fixed-amount deposits, and custom installment frequencies.
app.dashboard.emptyStateTitle: Create your first deposit plan record
app.dashboard.emptyStateSubtitle: Define deposit percentage or amount, installment count, and frequency. Pair each active plan with an automatic discount trigger to collect deposits at checkout; balances are collected through payment request links.
app.dashboard.createOnlySavesHint: Creating a plan here only saves its configuration and math. DepositCraft never changes checkout’s amount due on its own.
app.dashboard.paymentRequestInfoIcon: A payment request for the first installment is only created later, from an existing order, and only after the merchant publishes the Payment Request Page.
app.dashboard.statPaymentsInfo: Create payment links from the DepositCraft card on each order. Customers pay manually; the next link is created after Wix marks the previous request paid.
app.dashboard.configuredPlansSubtitle: Configure plans and preview their math. Saving here does not change checkout or collect payment.
app.deleteModal.title: Delete this deposit plan?
app.deleteModal.body: This removes the plan named “{name}” after you save configuration. Any order already using this plan keeps its existing payment schedule.
app.simulator.title: Checkout layaway simulator
app.simulator.subtitle: Preview how the deposit and installment breakdown would look to a shopper
app.simulator.downPayments: {value} down, {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}
app.simulator.installmentDueIn: In {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
app.simulator.previewFootnote: Preview only. Supports both Catalog V1 and V3 products.
app.dashboard.beforeAffectsCheckoutBody: Saving here only updates the plan configuration and preview math. For an existing order, DepositCraft can request the first installment payment and moves to the next one only after that payment is recorded. This needs the merchant’s Payment Request Page to be published; DepositCraft never charges a buyer automatically or adds a deposit to checkout on its own.
app.dashboard.saveFailedToast: Your changes were not saved. Please try again.
app.modal.alreadyHaveActivePlans: You already have {limit, plural, one {# active plan} other {# active plans}} on the free plan. This new plan will be saved but turned off until you upgrade or turn another plan off.
app.modal.needsProPlan: This plan needs the Pro plan.
app.modal.notAvailableOnCurrentPlan: This plan is not available on your current plan.
app.modal.freeFixedDepositMessage: Fixed-amount deposits need the Pro plan. The free plan supports percentage-based deposits.
app.modal.freeCustomFrequencyMessage: Custom installment schedules need the Pro plan. The free plan uses a bi-weekly schedule.
app.modal.freeRuleLimitMessage: The free plan supports up to {limit, plural, one {# active deposit plan} other {# active deposit plans}}. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited plans.
app.modal.depositTypeInfo: Percentage deposits scale with the order total. Fixed deposits collect the same amount every time.
app.modal.installmentFrequencyInfo: Custom frequencies need the Pro plan. Free plans use every 2 weeks.
app.modal.collectionIdsInfo: Find collection IDs in Wix Stores > Collections.
app.modal.planCreatedToast: Plan created. Click “Save configuration” to keep it.
app.modal.planRemovedToast: Plan removed. Click “Save configuration” to keep this change.
app.order.orderTotalMissing: This order does not have a payable total yet.
app.order.loadFailed: We could not load this order’s DepositCraft plans right now.
app.order.noActivePlans: No active deposit plans are saved yet. Add one from the DepositCraft dashboard page.
app.order.allPaid: All scheduled payments are collected for this order.
app.order.partiallyPaid: {paidCount} of {totalInstallments} scheduled payments collected. DepositCraft creates the next payment link after Wix marks the previous request paid.
app.order.paymentLinkFootnote: Your site needs a published Payment Request Page. Customers pay manually through this link. DepositCraft does not auto-charge saved cards or send email on its own — use Automations (Installment due reminder) for scheduled reminders.
app.order.paymentRequestCreatedToast: Payment request created. Share the link with your customer.
app.order.paymentRequestFailedToast: DepositCraft could not create a payment request.
app.order.noPaymentPlanToast: No DepositCraft payment plan exists for this order yet.
app.order.paymentSyncFailedToast: DepositCraft could not refresh payment status.
app.order.allCollectedOrOpenToast: All scheduled payments are collected or already have an open payment link.
app.order.paymentAdvanceFailedToast: DepositCraft could not create the next payment link.
app.ledger.title: Payment ledger
app.ledger.subtitle: Installment payments recorded for orders that used a deposit plan.
app.ledger.emptyStateSubtitle: Payment ledger entries appear here after a customer completes a deposit checkout.
app.ledger.countPartial: Showing {shown, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}. More are available.
app.ledger.countComplete: Showing all {shown, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}.
app.ledger.loadErrorToast: DepositCraft could not load the payment ledger.
app.storage.preparingBody: Setting up DepositCraft storage — this usually finishes within a few minutes. This page updates automatically.
